title: Zero-Query Transferable Pretend Benign Attacks with Amortized Online Generation for Cooperative Perception
title_zh: 面向协同感知的零查询可迁移伪装良性攻击与摊销式在线生成

paragraphs.en: 提出可迁移伪装良性攻击RT-TrPB以近100%成功率绕过协同感知防御，并提出STTrust防御方法恢复感知性能。 Cooperative perception enables an ego agent to acquire information from collaborators beyond its own sensors' reach. Yet, the most beneficial messages are often the hardest to verify from local observations. Pretend Benign (PB) exploits this asymmetry by targeting regions with weak local verifiability and applying multi-objective perturbations, making harmful feature changes appear to be benign assistance. However, PB is victim-dependent: selecting regions and optimizing perturbations require the victim model's architecture, parameters, and gradients, limiting transfer to unseen victims. A transferable attack must capture properties shared across cooperative detection models rather than those specific to one network. We address this by building a victim-agnostic attack from a heterogeneous ensemble of surrogate models and encoding its capabilities in a reusable dictionary to reduce per-message generation cost. Specifically, Transferable Pretend Benign (TrPB) transfers PB's region selection criterion and multi-objective perturbation strategy across heterogeneous surrogates to construct an offline attack. We further propose RT-TrPB, which encodes transferable regions and perturbation patterns into a region predictor and reusable perturbation dictionary, amortizing per-message attack generation. Experiments on widely used cooperative perception benchmarks show that RT-TrPB bypasses the consensus-based defenses ROBOSAC and FLD with success rates approaching 100% and generates each perturbation in under 56 ms. To counter PB-style attacks masquerading as benign collaboration, we also propose STTrust, which verifies received messages using spatial and temporal consistency and incorporates identity-level trust. STTrust detects over 90% of PB-style attacks and restores perception performance to near the attack-free level.
paragraphs.zh: 提出可迁移伪装良性攻击RT-TrPB，以接近100%的成功率绕过协同感知防御，并提出STTrust防御方法以恢复感知性能。协同感知使智能体（ego agent）能够从协作者处获取超出自身传感器覆盖范围的信息。 然而，最有价值的消息往往是仅凭本地观测最难验证的。 伪装良性（PB）攻击正是利用了这种不对称性：它瞄准本地可验证性较弱的区域并施加多目标扰动，使有害的特征变化看起来像是良性的协助。 然而，PB攻击依赖于受害模型：选择区域和优化扰动需要受害模型的结构、参数和梯度，这限制了向未见过的受害模型的迁移能力。 可迁移攻击必须捕捉协同检测模型之间共有的属性，而不是某一特定网络独有的属性。 为解决这一问题，我们基于异构代理模型集合构建了一种与受害模型无关的攻击，并将其能力编码到一个可复用的字典中，以降低每条消息的生成成本。 具体而言，可迁移伪装良性攻击（TrPB）将PB的区域选择准则和多目标扰动策略迁移到异构代理模型上，构建离线攻击。 我们进一步提出RT-TrPB，它将可迁移的区域和扰动模式编码为区域预测器和可复用扰动字典，从而摊销每条消息的攻击生成成本。 在广泛使用的协同感知基准上的实验表明，RT-TrPB以接近100%的成功率绕过基于共识的防御方法ROBOSAC和FLD，且每生成一个扰动用时不足56毫秒。 为对抗伪装成良性协作的PB式攻击，我们还提出STTrust，它利用空间和时间一致性验证接收到的消息，并引入身份级信任机制。 STTrust可检测超过90%的PB式攻击，并将感知性能恢复到接近无攻击水平。
